atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Range Coil Lookback", 10, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 99, 1)
predThresh = input(0.6, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
relMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1]))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low

lessA = 0.0
lessR = 0.0
j = 1
while j < coilLen {
  if atrVal[j] < atrVal {
    lessA = lessA + 1
  }
  if rng[j] < rng {
    lessR = lessR + 1
  }
  j = j + 1
}
denom = max(coilLen - 1, 1)
atrRank = lessA / denom
rngRank = lessR / denom
coilLoad = 100 - 50 * (atrRank + rngRank) / 2

atrMeanV = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrSdV = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSdV / max(atrMeanV, 0.000000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vov[1] > vov[2]

sumSigned = 0.0
sumAbs = 0.0
k = 0
while k < predLen {
  d = close[k] - close[k + 1]
  sumSigned = sumSigned + d
  sumAbs = sumAbs + abs(d)
  k = k + 1
}
predict = abs(sumSigned) / max(sumAbs, 0.000000001)

rangeMean = sma(rng, coilLen)
rangeRatio = rng / max(rangeMean, 0.000000001)
lowestAtr = lowest(atrVal, coilLen)
atrRatio = atrVal / max(lowestAtr, 0.000000001)
releaseEnergy = (rangeRatio + atrRatio) / 2

coiledChop = coilLoad > coilThresh and predict <= predThresh
buyCond = coilLoad > coilThresh and predict > predThresh and releaseEnergy > relMult and close > open and vovRising
sellCond = coilLoad > coilThresh and predict > predThresh and releaseEnergy > relMult and close < open and vovRising
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predict, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predict, "Predictability 3D", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Model — session extremes + confirmed 1h structure + model.* execution
sessLen = input(20, "Session Length (bars)", 5, 200, 1)
stf = input("1h", "Structure Timeframe")
confBars = input(2, "Structure Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
hardStopTicks = input(20, "Hard Stop (ticks)", 1, 200, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessRange = sessHigh - sessLow

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfHighPrev = htfHigh[1]
htfLowPrev = htfLow[1]

bullBreak = htfClose > htfHighPrev
bearBreak = htfClose < htfLowPrev

bullDist = htfClose - htfHighPrev
bearDist = htfLowPrev - htfClose
bullQualRaw = sessRange > 0 ? bullDist / sessRange * 100 : 0
bearQualRaw = sessRange > 0 ? bearDist / sessRange * 100 : 0
bullQualCap = bullQualRaw > 100 ? 100 : bullQualRaw
bullQual = bullQualCap < 0 ? 0 : bullQualCap
bearQualCap = bearQualRaw > 100 ? 100 : bearQualRaw
bearQual = bearQualCap < 0 ? 0 : bearQualCap

var bullCount = 0.0
var bearCount = 0.0
var entryPx = 0.0
var isLong = 0.0
var isShort = 0.0

if bullBreak {
    bullCount := bullCount[1] + 1
} else {
    bullCount := 0
}
if bearBreak {
    bearCount := bearCount[1] + 1
} else {
    bearCount := 0
}

confirmedBull = bullCount >= confBars
confirmedBear = bearCount >= confBars
confidence = confirmedBull ? bullQual : confirmedBear ? bearQual : 0

stopOffset = hardStopTicks * 0.1
longStopLvl = entryPx - stopOffset
shortStopLvl = entryPx + stopOffset

breakHigh = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
breakLow = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])

buySig = breakHigh and confirmedBull and confidence >= confThresh and isLong == 0 and isShort == 0
sellSig = breakLow and confirmedBear and confidence >= confThresh and isLong == 0 and isShort == 0

longStopHit = isLong == 1 and low <= longStopLvl
shortStopHit = isShort == 1 and high >= shortStopLvl
longExitRule = isLong == 1 and (breakLow or longStopHit)
shortExitRule = isShort == 1 and (breakHigh or shortStopHit)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopOffset, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    isLong := 1
    isShort := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopOffset, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    isShort := 1
    isLong := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitRule {
    model.longExit("siege")
    isLong := 0
    entryPx := 0
}
if shortExitRule {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    isShort := 0
    entryPx := 0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

bearLevel = input(-0.2, "Skew Bearish Flip Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)

ret = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.000000001)

slowRV = stdev(ret, slowLen)
highestHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
lowestLow = lowest(low, skewLen)

spreadFastMed = fastRV - medRV

expanded = compressed[1] and fastRV > medRV and fastRV > fastRV[1] and spreadRising

bearFlip = skew[1] >= bearLevel and skew < bearLevel
bullRecent = bullFlip or bullFlip[1] or bullFlip[2]
bearRecent = bearFlip or bearFlip[1] or bearFlip[2]
buySig = expanded and bullRecent
sellSig = expanded and bearRecent

avgCrossDown = AVG < sellLevel and AVG[1] >= sellLevel

wx = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wy = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wz = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
baseSpeed = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpd = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 1.0)
maxSpd = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
perKnot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.01, 0.5, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

gust = close - open
rangeBar = high - low
momBar = change(close)
xd = wx + 0.05 * gust
yd = wy + 0.05 * rangeBar
zd = wz + 0.05 * momBar
denom = abs(xd) + abs(yd) + abs(zd) + 0.00001
xn = xd / denom
yn = yd / denom
zn = zd / denom
yawDeg = xn * 180.0 + yn * 45.0
pitchDeg = zn * 90.0
rollDeg = 0.0
windSpeedRaw = baseSpeed + gust * 0.5 + rangeBar * 0.25
windSpeed = windSpeedRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : windSpeedRaw
tailRaw = baseTail + perKnot * windSpeed
tailLen = tailRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : tailRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : tailRaw
span = maxSpd - minSpd + 0.00001
tRaw = (windSpeed - minSpd) / span
tMid = tRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : tRaw
tNorm = tMid > 1.0 ? 1.0 : tMid
windColor = tNorm < 0.25 ? "#2266ff" : tNorm < 0.5 ? "#33aaff" : tNorm < 0.75 ? "#ffaa33" : "#ff8800"
arrowSizeRaw = tailLen * markerSize
arrowSize = arrowSizeRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : arrowSizeRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : arrowSizeRaw
highLevel = maxSpd * 0.8
calmLevel = minSpd + 5.0
highCond = windSpeed > highLevel
calmCond = windSpeed < calmLevel
highPrev = highCond[1]
calmPrev = calmCond[1]
highSig = highCond and not highPrev
calmSig = calmCond and not calmPrev
dYaw = abs(yawDeg - yawDeg[1])
dPitch = abs(pitchDeg - pitchDeg[1])
shiftCond = dYaw > 30.0 or dPitch > 30.0
shiftPrev = shiftCond[1]
shiftSig = shiftCond and not shiftPrev
windArrowState = highCond or calmCond or shiftCond
windArrowPrev = windArrowState[1]
windArrowSig = windArrowState and not windArrowPrev

if highSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangleup", "#ff8800")
}
if calmSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangledown", "#2266ff")
}
if shiftSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#aa44ff")
}
if windArrowSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, close, "WindArrow", "diamond", windColor)
}
plot(windSpeed, "Wind Speed Knots", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot(tNorm, "Speed Norm", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot3d(windSpeed, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#ff8800", "separate", 0)
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "trail", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)
if windArrowSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "WindArrow", "diamond", windColor, arrowSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if highSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "HighWind3D", "coneup", "#ff8800", markerSize, 2, "separate", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
}
if calmSig {

}

}
